question.worked_solution:
The range of $\sqrt[4]{x}$ is

$$
\sqrt[4]{x}\ge 0.
$$

Horizontal shifts and stretches do not affect the range. Hence,

$$
\sqrt[4]{5x+2}\ge 0.
$$

Multiplying the above inequality by $-4,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt[4]{5x+2} & \ge 0 \\ -4\sqrt[4]{5x+2} & \le 0.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the range of the given function is 
$h(x)\in (-\infty ,0].$

We can also see that this is true from the graph of the function. The graph of $y=h(x)$ is shown below.
